up: Retrieve the exact IC50 activity values (standard_value in nM) for compounds tested against human Poly [ADP-ribose] polymerase 1 (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL3105). For each qualifying activity, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, the exact IC50 value in nM, and the PubMed ID or DOI from the associated document.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value AS ic50_nM, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3105' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '='
